{{Quote|You have heard of our plight with the smugglers here on Talus?|[[Kiki Dorente]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Talk to Kiki|Talus}}</ref>}}
The '''Talusian Smugglers''' were a band of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that operated on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|There is a den of Selonians just outside Nashal that are being exploited by a group of smugglers. It appears the smugglers have some of the den's people, and are using them to coerce the rest of the den into mining for them.|[[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TtT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Travel to Talus|Talus}}</ref>}}
The Talusian Smugglers were active on Talus, in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] during the Galactic Civil War. They had a [[Smuggler Base|base]] located near the city of [[Nashal]].<ref name="SWG:FaW" />
[[File:Smuggler_Base.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Smuggler Base]].]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the smugglers turned their activities to [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. They made an arrangement with a traitorous member of the [[Neetha Den]], a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] [[Den (Selonian)|den]] who lived in a [[Neetha Den's cave|cave]] near the smuggler base. The traitor proposed the so-called Askura deal to the [[den mother]] [[Kiisa Kimotte]] and the other Selonians as a partnership with the smugglers. However, the deal was fake and the Selonians were soon exploited by the smugglers. The smugglers captured several Selonians and kept them as hostages in order to force the rest of the den into mining for them.<ref name="SWG:AtDM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Address the Den Mother|Talus}}</ref> In fact, the captive Selonians were shipped to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]]. Nevertheless, not all the smugglers agreed with that and some considered they could make a fine profit without having to exploit the Selonians.<ref name="SWG:GtM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Gather the Missing|Talus}}</ref> The situation generated [[Anti-Humanism|anti-human]] sentiments among the Selonian population of Talus and hostile anti-human demonstrations erupted in the city of Nashal. Despite no act of violence against Humans was reported, the local [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] and the [[Cluster World Relations]] agency issued a travel warning for Nashal. Via [[Corellia News Service]], [[Marx Grocco]], Director of Cluster World Relations, explained that this preventive measure was meant to insure the public safety of Talusian human citizens and human travelers for any possible hostile encounters with non-human protestors.<ref name="web">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?id=66901&resource=features|text=Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Corellian Security Force]] was aware of the situation but the smugglers used the fact that the CorSec could not intervene in Selonians matters. However, [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Taarna]] then recruited an independent spacer in order to help the Selonians without involving the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:TtT" /> The spacer later worked with [[Tika Sileste]],<ref name="SWG:EaW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Exploiting a Weakness|Talus}}</ref> [[Ravi Thienta]],<ref name="SWG:UYT" /> [[Lika Fimente]]<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> and [[Kiki Dorente]], the advisor to the Neetha den mother, to develop a strategy against the smugglers.<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> The spacer then attacked the base and killed many smugglers, including their leader. The spacer also destroyed the smugglers' droids,<ref name="SWG:EaW" /> and the weapon caches, and retrieved stolen Selonian supplies of food, hides and electronic parts.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /> Although the spacer eventually discovered that the captive Selonians had already been sold as slaves,<ref name="SWG:GtM" /> the assault severely weakened the smugglers and crippled their ability to exploit the Selonians.<ref name="SWG:UYT" /><ref name="SWG:AtDM" /><ref name="SWG:EaW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Talusian Smugglers appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Talusian Smugglers were added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
